query:
SELECT t.id FROM tracks t
        WHERE t.id IN (SELECT track_id FROM track_credits WHERE artist_id = ANY($3))
          AND t.id <> $1
          AND t.id <> ALL($5)
          AND t.merged_into IS NULL
          AND similarity(t.title, $2) >= $4
        ORDER BY similarity(t.title, $2) DESC, t.id
        LIMIT 10
